test_scalar_non_numeric_indexers: test that float scalar indexers raise KeyError on non-numeric index types like strings, dates, and periods
test_float_scalar_on_integer_index: test that float scalar indexers coerce to equal int on integer-based indexes for getitem and setitem
test_float_slice_on_non_numeric_index: test that float slices raise TypeError on non-numeric index types like strings, dates, and periods
test_float_slice_on_integer_index: test float slice behavior on integer indexes including out-of-bounds and odd float boundaries
test_float_index_misc_operations: test scalar lookup, label slicing, fancy indexing, and list selection on float indexes
